6. Warranty period and what it covers, and whether installation (the application work) is included, with its duration on site.

Please keep your company name, phone numbers, emails and links out of the quote, because they are removed until the customer pays to reveal you.

One question to start: are you quoting the whole BOQ line, or is any part excluded or by others?
